lead.headline: Wilson is active — Diggs' 20.3 is the bar
lead.deck: The 10:30 lists cleared every starter. One free slot swap before noon; then nothing to do.
lead.body: The bad news is on your bench: Stefon Diggs' 20.3 from Thursday, which Garrett Wilson now has to beat from the WR slot. And the receiver you added this morning, Jaylen Waddle, is on Denver's bye and still has a Week 9 concussion to clear before Week 11 — he cost you Tyler Allgeier. The inactive lists then went your way: Wilson is officially active, and so are Boston and Etienne. Minnesota ruled out Jordan Addison, so Justin Jefferson is Kirk Cousins' only established receiver. One free move before noon: put Warren in FLEX and Gordon at RB, so Metcalf can cover Warren if Sunday night's list surprises. ESPN gives you 75%.

doFirst.note: The lineup as set is the projection lineup; every noon starter is active. The slot swap is insurance for Warren's Sunday-night game, and it is in the brief's Do-first.
